LEAVE AND LICENSE AGREEMENT

This Leave and License Agreement (the "Agreement") is made and executed at Navi Mumbai on this 18th day of September, 2026.

BETWEEN

Mr. Sudhir Vasant Karandikar, aged about 61 years, Occupation: Retired, residing at Row House No. 3, Parijat Enclave, Sector 9, Vashi, Navi Mumbai 400703, hereinafter referred to as the "Licensor" (which expression shall, unless it be repugnant to the context or meaning thereof, mean and include his heirs, executors, administrators and assigns) of the ONE PART;

AND

Ms. Ishita Mohan Bhardwaj, aged about 27 years, Occupation: Service, permanently residing at 14, Ganga Vihar Colony, Tonk Road, Jaipur, Rajasthan 302018, hereinafter referred to as the "Licensee" (which expression shall, unless it be repugnant to the context or meaning thereof, mean and include her heirs, executors and administrators) of the OTHER PART.

The Licensor and the Licensee are hereinafter individually referred to as a "Party" and collectively as the "Parties".

WHEREAS:

A. The Licensor is the sole and absolute owner of, and is otherwise well and sufficiently entitled to, the residential flat bearing No. 1104 on the 11th floor of B-Wing of the building known as Sahyadri Vista, of Sahyadri Vista Co-operative Housing Society Limited (the "Society"), situated on Plot No. 14, Sector 21, Kharghar, Navi Mumbai 410210, admeasuring approximately 680 square feet carpet area, together with one covered car parking space bearing No. B-27, as more particularly described in the Schedule hereunder written (the "Licensed Premises").

B. The Licensee has approached the Licensor with a request to grant to her a license to use and occupy the Licensed Premises on a temporary basis for her residential use, and the Licensor has agreed to grant such license on the terms and conditions hereinafter appearing.

C. The Parties are desirous of recording the terms of the said license in writing and of registering this Agreement as required by law.

NOW THIS AGREEMENT WITNESSETH AND IT IS HEREBY AGREED BY AND BETWEEN THE PARTIES AS FOLLOWS:

1. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATION
1.1 In this Agreement, unless the context otherwise requires, "Commencement Date" means 1st October, 2026; "License Period" means the period referred to in Clause 3.1; "License Fee" means the monthly license fee referred to in Clause 4.1; and "Security Deposit" means the interest-free refundable deposit referred to in Clause 5.1.
1.2 The headings in this Agreement are for convenience only and shall not affect its interpretation. Words importing the singular include the plural and vice versa, and words importing one gender include every gender.

2. GRANT OF LICENSE
2.1 The Licensor hereby grants to the Licensee, and the Licensee hereby accepts, a leave and license to use and occupy the Licensed Premises for residential purposes only, on the terms and conditions set out in this Agreement.
2.2 The Licensed Premises are given on a semi-furnished basis, together with the furniture, fixtures, fittings and electrical appliances presently installed therein.
2.3 Nothing contained in this Agreement shall be construed as creating any tenancy, sub-tenancy, lease or other right, title or interest in the Licensed Premises in favour of the Licensee. The legal possession of the Licensed Premises shall at all times remain with the Licensor, and the Licensee shall only be entitled to use the Licensed Premises as a licensee during the License Period.

3. LICENSE PERIOD
3.1 This license shall be for a period of eleven (11) months commencing from the Commencement Date and ending on 31st August, 2027 (both days inclusive), unless terminated earlier in accordance with this Agreement.
3.2 The Parties may, by mutual consent recorded in writing, renew this license for a further period on such terms, including a revised License Fee, as may be agreed between them at that time. Any such renewal shall be by a fresh agreement, which shall be duly stamped and registered.

4. LICENSE FEE AND OTHER CHARGES
4.1 The Licensee shall pay to the Licensor a monthly License Fee of Rs. 32,000/- (Rupees Thirty-Two Thousand only) for the use of the Licensed Premises.
4.2 The License Fee shall be payable in advance on or before the 5th day of each English calendar month by bank transfer to the account designated by the Licensor in writing.
4.3 If any License Fee or other amount payable by the Licensee is not paid on its due date, the Licensee shall pay interest on the outstanding amount at the rate of twenty-four percent (24%) per annum from the due date until the date of actual payment, together with a late payment charge of Rs. 500/- (Rupees Five Hundred only) for every day of delay.
4.4 In addition to the License Fee, the Licensee shall bear and pay the monthly maintenance charges of the Society, together with all special levies, sinking fund contributions, repair fund contributions and non-occupancy charges levied by the Society in respect of the Licensed Premises during the License Period.
4.5 The Licensee shall pay the electricity charges as per the bills of the electricity supply company, the piped gas charges, and the charges for internet and cable television directly to the concerned service providers, and shall produce the paid receipts to the Licensor on demand.
4.6 The municipal property tax in respect of the Licensed Premises shall be borne and paid by the Licensor.

5. SECURITY DEPOSIT
5.1 The Licensee has, on or before the execution of this Agreement, paid to the Licensor an interest-free refundable Security Deposit of Rs. 1,50,000/- (Rupees One Lakh Fifty Thousand only) by bank transfer, the receipt whereof the Licensor hereby admits and acknowledges.
5.2 The Security Deposit shall not carry any interest and shall not be adjusted by the Licensee against the License Fee or any other amount payable under this Agreement.
5.3 The Security Deposit shall be refunded to the Licensee within a reasonable time after the Licensee has handed over vacant and peaceful possession of the Licensed Premises to the Licensor, subject to the deductions permitted under this Clause 5.
5.4 The Licensor shall be entitled to deduct from the Security Deposit such amounts as the Licensor may, in his sole discretion, consider necessary towards unpaid dues, damage to the Licensed Premises or its contents, cleaning, and any other expenses incurred by the Licensor on account of the Licensee.
5.5 Notwithstanding anything contained in this Agreement, a sum equal to one (1) month's License Fee shall in all cases be retained by the Licensor from the Security Deposit towards repainting of the Licensed Premises, irrespective of the condition in which the Licensed Premises are handed back.
5.6 If the amounts due from the Licensee exceed the Security Deposit, the Licensee shall pay the shortfall to the Licensor within seven (7) days of a written demand.

6. LOCK-IN PERIOD
6.1 The Licensee agrees that the first eight (8) months of the License Period, that is, from 1st October, 2026 to 31st May, 2027, shall be a lock-in period during which the Licensee shall not terminate this Agreement or vacate the Licensed Premises.
6.2 If the Licensee terminates this Agreement or vacates the Licensed Premises for any reason before the expiry of the lock-in period, the Licensee shall be liable to pay to the Licensor the License Fee for the entire unexpired portion of the lock-in period, and the Licensor shall be entitled to recover such amount from the Security Deposit.

7. TERMINATION AND NOTICE
7.1 This Agreement shall stand terminated automatically on the expiry of the License Period, unless renewed in accordance with Clause 3.2.
7.2 After the expiry of the lock-in period, the Licensee may terminate this Agreement by giving to the Licensor not less than thirty (30) days' prior written notice.
7.3 The Licensor may terminate this Agreement at any time, including during the lock-in period, by giving the Licensee fifteen (15) days' written notice, without assigning any reason.
7.4 If the Licensee commits a breach of any of the terms of this Agreement, including non-payment of the License Fee for two consecutive months, the Licensor shall be entitled to terminate this Agreement forthwith by written notice and to recover possession of the Licensed Premises in accordance with law.

8. HANDING OVER OF POSSESSION
8.1 On the expiry or earlier termination of this Agreement, the Licensee shall hand over vacant and peaceful possession of the Licensed Premises to the Licensor in the same condition in which it was handed over to her, reasonable wear and tear excepted, together with all keys, access cards and remote controls.
8.2 If the Licensee fails to hand over vacant possession of the Licensed Premises on the expiry or earlier termination of this Agreement, the Licensee shall be liable to pay to the Licensor damages calculated at three (3) times the License Fee, on a per-day basis, for every day of such unauthorised occupation, without prejudice to the other rights and remedies of the Licensor.
8.3 The Licensor shall not be responsible for any articles left behind by the Licensee in the Licensed Premises after the Licensee has handed over possession.

9. REPAIRS AND MAINTENANCE
9.1 The Licensee shall keep the Licensed Premises, and the furniture, fixtures and fittings therein, in a good, clean and tenantable condition.
9.2 The Licensee shall, at her own cost, carry out all repairs to the Licensed Premises, whether minor or major, including repairs to plumbing, electrical wiring, water seepage and leakage, and the replacement of any fixture or appliance that ceases to function during the License Period.
9.3 The Licensee shall not make any structural additions or alterations to the Licensed Premises, nor drill into or fix anything to the external walls, without the prior written consent of the Licensor.

10. USE OF THE LICENSED PREMISES
10.1 The Licensee shall use the Licensed Premises only for the residence of herself and her immediate family members, and for no other purpose whatsoever.
10.2 The Licensee shall not sub-license, sublet, assign or part with the possession of the Licensed Premises or any part thereof, or permit any other person to occupy the same.
10.3 Guests of the Licensee shall not stay overnight in the Licensed Premises for more than three (3) nights in any calendar month without the prior written consent of the Licensor.
10.4 The Licensee shall observe and comply with the bye-laws, rules and regulations of the Society, and shall not cause any nuisance or annoyance to the other members and occupants of the building.
10.5 The Licensee shall not store any hazardous, combustible or illegal goods in the Licensed Premises, and shall not carry on any unlawful or immoral activity therein.

11. INSPECTION AND ACCESS
11.1 The Licensor, and any person authorised by him, shall be entitled to enter upon the Licensed Premises at all reasonable times, with or without prior notice to the Licensee, to inspect the condition of the Licensed Premises or to show the same to prospective licensees or purchasers.
11.2 The Licensee shall give the Licensor and the Society access to the Licensed Premises for carrying out any repairs to the common areas of the building that require such access.

12. REGISTRATION, STAMP DUTY AND POLICE INTIMATION
12.1 This Agreement shall be registered with the office of the Sub-Registrar of Assurances in accordance with Section 55 of the Maharashtra Rent Control Act, 1999, and the Parties shall cooperate in completing the registration, including through the online e-registration facility where available.
12.2 The entire stamp duty and registration charges payable on this Agreement, and all incidental expenses thereof, shall be borne and paid solely by the Licensee.
12.3 The Licensor shall furnish the particulars of the Licensee to the local police station as required by the orders of the police authorities in force, and the Licensee shall provide such identity documents and photographs as may be required for this purpose.

13. MISCELLANEOUS
13.1 The Licensor confirms that he has intimated the Society about the grant of this license and has obtained its no-objection wherever required under the bye-laws of the Society.
13.2 Any notice under this Agreement shall be in writing and shall be delivered by hand, by registered post acknowledgement due, or by email to such email address as each Party may notify to the other in writing.
13.3 This Agreement constitutes the entire agreement between the Parties with respect to its subject matter and supersedes all prior discussions and understandings. No modification of this Agreement shall be valid unless it is made in writing and signed by both Parties.
13.4 If any provision of this Agreement is held to be invalid or unenforceable, the remaining provisions shall continue in full force and effect.

THE SCHEDULE ABOVE REFERRED TO
(Description of the Licensed Premises)

Residential flat bearing No. 1104, on the 11th floor, B-Wing, in the building known as Sahyadri Vista of Sahyadri Vista Co-operative Housing Society Limited, constructed on Plot No. 14, Sector 21, Kharghar, Navi Mumbai 410210, within the limits of the Panvel Municipal Corporation, admeasuring approximately 680 square feet carpet area, together with covered car parking space No. B-27, and bounded as follows: on or towards the East by an internal road; on or towards the West by Plot No. 15; on or towards the North by an open space; and on or towards the South by Plot No. 13.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF the Parties hereto have set and subscribed their respective hands on the day and year first hereinabove written.
